# Contractions

> **这页管什么**：缩写形式鼓励用，尤其否定式——don't 比 do not 更不容易看漏。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/contractions> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## General

The guide favours an informal tone and recommends common two-word contractions: *you're*, *don't*, *there's*.

## Negation contractions — encouraged

Specifically recommends *isn't*, *don't*, *can't*.

Rationale: it's easy for a reader scanning text to miss the word *not*, but hard to misread *don't* as *do*.

When the negative needs emphasis, use formatting (`is <em>not</em>`) rather than dropping the contraction — though this is rarely necessary.

## Contractions to avoid

1. **Nonstandard or invented contractions** — *guides're*, or *browser's* meaning "browser is".
2. **Three-word contractions** — *mightn't've*.
